aesKeysHint: The device address is the manufacturer code plus the device ID, e.g. AAA-12345678. A key is either 32 hex characters or a 16 character plain text key.
blocklistHint: Telegrams of the listed devices are ignored completely. Enter the device address, e.g. AAA-12345678.
Check for new devices that need a key: Check for new devices that need a key
ignoreUnknownDevicesHelp: Telegrams of devices that do not have an object tree yet are ignored, so no new devices are created. A device deleted from the object tree stays gone.
importNeedsKeyConfirm: Adds devices the adapter has found without a usable key and that are not in the list yet, with a placeholder key. Nothing is saved: fill in the keys and save when you are done. This does not update by itself - devices found later need another click.
importNeedsKeyAdded: Added %s device(s) that need a key
importNeedsKeyNothing: No device is waiting for a key
keysIgnoredHint: The option "Only handle devices that already have an object tree" is switched on: telegrams of devices without one are dropped, so no device can be waiting for a key. Switch it off to set up a new meter.
Only handle devices that already have an: Only handle devices that already have an object tree
serialPortHelp: Select a port or type one in - for a serial device reachable over the network use tcp://host:port
Temporarily block device after consecuti: Temporarily block device after consecutive failures
